integrity: The source defining set is reconstructed over \(\mathbb F_{27}\), and the published ordinary enumerator, dimension, and generalized Hamming hierarchy are independently reproduced. All \(211\) positive-dimensional message subspaces are then enumerated exactly once in reduced-row-echelon form to obtain the complete support distributions.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite support census for the \(q=3\), \(m=z=3\), \(s=1\) code in Examples 3.4 and 3.8. It does not give a general subcode-support distribution for either full defining-set family and does not classify subcodes up to automorphism.
title: Complete subcode-support distribution of the optimal \([24,4,15]_3\) defining-set code
